launch.title: A LITTLE CARE BEFORE THEY ARRIVE
launch.caption: FormBridge · The restaurant enquiry desk
launch.voice: Good hospitality starts before the guest arrives. FormBridge gives your restaurant one place to look after every enquiry.

launch.title: WELCOME THE CONVERSATION
launch.caption: A guest assistant with your restaurant’s approved information
launch.voice: Let guests ask questions and share their plans through your own restaurant assistant.

launch.title: BRING THE TEAM TOGETHER
launch.caption: Every request. A clear next step.
launch.voice: Requests arrive in a private team inbox, with the conversation and booking details together.

launch.title: NOTICE THE PERSONAL DETAILS
launch.caption: Guest requests, with the words that support them
launch.voice: Spot the birthday, the quiet table and the dietary request. Check the guest's words before keeping each detail.

launch.title: FOLLOW THROUGH
launch.caption: Owners, reminders and notes for the next shift
launch.voice: Give the enquiry an owner, a reminder and a useful handoff. Keep the next shift in the picture.

launch.title: GIVE GUESTS A CHANCE TO CHECK
launch.caption: Private review links. Changes return to the team.
launch.voice: Share a private review link. When plans change, the request comes back for another staff review.

launch.title: TRY THE COMPLETE HANDOFF

launch.voice: Test channel messages and reservation handoffs with clearly labelled simulations. No real messages or reservations are sent.

launch.title: FORMBRIDGE
launch.caption: A warmer welcome starts with clearer details.
launch.voice: FormBridge. Clear details, thoughtful service. Bring your own restaurant enquiry and make the next step easier.

walkthrough.title: MEET FORMBRIDGE
walkthrough.caption: From the first message to a thoughtful handoff
walkthrough.voice: FormBridge helps restaurant teams turn changing conversations into booking briefs. Let's follow a birthday enquiry through the guest assistant and into the staff desk.

walkthrough.title: 01 · GIVE THE ASSISTANT YOUR RESTAURANT
walkthrough.caption: Publish only the information your team has approved
walkthrough.voice: Start in the restaurant library. Add the name, city and information your team has checked. Only approved facts are published to the guest assistant. You can share its page or embed it on your website.

walkthrough.title: 02 · ANSWER WITH APPROVED INFORMATION
walkthrough.caption: Opening hours and policies, grounded in your library
walkthrough.voice: Guests can ask about the restaurant before making a request. Here, the answer uses the opening hours the team approved. Missing information is left for staff to answer.

walkthrough.title: 03 · GATHER THE REQUEST
walkthrough.caption: A birthday dinner, a quieter table and a dietary request
walkthrough.voice: Alex asks for a birthday dinner for five. The assistant gathers the date, time and party size. Alex adds contact details and agrees to send the request. A reservation has not been made.

walkthrough.title: 04 · PICK UP THE CONVERSATION
walkthrough.caption: The request arrives in a private team inbox
walkthrough.voice: The enquiry now appears in the team's inbox. Staff can see the requested booking details, open the full conversation and decide what needs attention.

walkthrough.title: 05 · REVIEW THE LITTLE DETAILS
walkthrough.caption: A source quotation for each guest-care suggestion
walkthrough.voice: Ask FormBridge to find guest requests. It suggests the dietary requirement, seating preference and occasion, each with the customer's own words. Staff chooses which suggestions to keep.

walkthrough.title: 06 · CHECK THE BOOKING BRIEF
walkthrough.caption: Five booking details, linked to the conversation
walkthrough.voice: Review the restaurant, city, date, time and guest count. Open a detail to inspect its source, correct anything that needs attention, then approve and save the brief to the team.

walkthrough.title: 07 · MAKE THE NEXT STEP CLEAR
walkthrough.caption: Assignment, priority, due time and staff comments
walkthrough.voice: Give the enquiry an owner, set its priority and add an exact due time. Leave a note for the team. Reminders appear while the desk is open, with overdue escalation for managers.

walkthrough.title: 08 · LET THE GUEST CHECK
walkthrough.caption: A private review page with no staff notes or transcript
walkthrough.voice: Create a private review link from the saved, approved enquiry. The guest can check the booking details and preferences. Staff notes, contact details and the full conversation stay private.

walkthrough.title: 09 · HANDLE A CHANGE OF PLANS
walkthrough.caption: Corrections reopen the enquiry for staff review
walkthrough.voice: Alex changes the party size to six. The correction returns to the inbox, removes the previous approval and puts the enquiry back in needs reply. Staff reviews the updated request before the next handoff.

walkthrough.title: 10 · REMEMBER A RETURNING GUEST
walkthrough.caption: Reviewed guest records with enquiry history
walkthrough.voice: Link the enquiry to a guest record when you know it belongs to that person. Keep useful preferences and history together. Combining duplicate records requires a separate confirmation.

walkthrough.title: 11 · TRY THE CHANNEL WORKFLOW
walkthrough.caption: Email and WhatsApp simulations with threaded follow-ups
walkthrough.voice: The connections screen lets you test email and WhatsApp enquiries. Add a new message or a follow-up to an existing conversation. Draft a reply, check it, then send it within the simulation.

walkthrough.title: 12 · TEST A RESERVATION HANDOFF
walkthrough.caption: Simulated availability, confirmation and cancellation
walkthrough.voice: For a complete, approved brief, try a booking handoff. Choose a mock provider, check simulated availability and create a simulated reference. These connections do not contact a real booking platform.

walkthrough.title: READY FOR THE NEXT SHIFT
walkthrough.caption: The guest, the details and the next step in one place
walkthrough.voice: The team desk brings the work together: requests needing a reply, decisions under review, due reminders and returning guests. FormBridge keeps the information clear while your team makes the decisions.
